errors.notANumber: Enter a whole number, or leave the field empty.
errors.burstNeedsRate: Enter a requests-per-second limit too, or clear the burst.

canonicalHost.heading: Main name
canonicalHost.subtitle: Send visitors who arrive on the other form of your name to the one you choose, so every page has a single address.
canonicalHost.label: Main name

limits.heading: Uploads and caching
limits.subtitle: How large a request may be, and how long browsers may keep your static files.
limits.uploadHint: From {minimum} to {maximum} MiB; leave empty for the server's default. PHP has upload limits of its own, and the smaller of the two applies. Applies to PHP and reverse-proxied sites.
limits.cacheHint: From {minimum} to {maximum} days; leave empty to send no cache headers. Applies to PHP and static sites.

redirects.heading: Redirects
redirects.subtitle: Send visitors from an old address to a new one. Rules are applied for the paths you list.

basicAuth.heading: Password protection
basicAuth.subtitle: Ask visitors for a user name and a password before they see any page. Certificate renewal keeps working.
basicAuth.empty: This site is open to everyone.
basicAuth.keepPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the current password
basicAuth.hint: {count} of {maximum} users. Passwords are at least {length} characters and are never shown again.
basicAuth.confirmQuestion: From now on every visitor, search engines included, must sign in with one of these users to see any page of this site. Make sure you have noted the password.

ipRules.heading: Access by address
ipRules.subtitle: Let in only some networks, or keep some networks out.
ipRules.hint: One address or range per line, up to {maximum}. A list that allows only some addresses locks out everyone else, you included; leave it empty for no restriction.

requestRate.heading: Request limit
requestRate.subtitle: Slow down a visitor address that asks for too many pages too quickly. Over the limit, the site answers “too many requests” (429). Leave the limit empty for no restriction.
requestRate.rateHint: From {minimum} to {maximum}; leave empty for no limit. The limit counts the address that connects to the server: behind a proxy or CDN that is the proxy's address, so all its visitors share one limit.
requestRate.burstHint: From {minimum} to {maximum}; leave empty for none. A burst lets a page that loads many files at once through without being refused. Used only together with a limit.
